method: Sequential before/after native OpenXR runs, identical synthetic menu metadata and empty scene; 24 alternating transitions 600 ms apart. Captures outside measured interval. Exclude first/last 240-frame timing windows to avoid startup/capture contamination. Live frame sampling and existing tracing enabled equally.
verdict: No meaningful application FPS or CPU scene-render regression observed. Same draw calls and geometry; shared placement transform only.
limitations: Short isolated UI benchmark, not a heavy molecular-scene or compositor/through-lens guarantee. Existing control overlap remains.
tests: simulation panel animation midpoint, reversal, manual resize, clamps, and ray routing

sizing_recommendation.criterion: 99% empirical acquisition with both highest-error profiles, same seeded trials across native isolated rectangles
sizing_recommendation.default_decision: Retain 1.3x default: 5x would make whole panel about 3.6 m wide. Reflow/enlarge controls for accessibility instead.
